trigger: Public primitive called by reviewed gameplay, staff and XML callers; any Skill owner.
guards: Clamps raw base to 0..65535 tenths; ignores skill lock, individual cap and total cap.
maximum: Per skill 6553.5 points; aggregate sum of raw bases minus the current cap.
reason: Not a player entry point itself. All compiled direct callers and generic reflection writers are registered separately.

trigger: Individual skill cap primitive; staff, scrolls and NPC setup.
guards: Changes individual cap only, does not grant points or change total cap.
maximum: 0 new total excess; lowering an individual cap can leave that skill above its individual cap.
reason: Individual skill limits and aggregate real skill total are different invariants.

trigger: World skill deserialization; raw persisted values.
guards: Reads stored base/cap without enforcing the owner's total cap or lock.
maximum: Preserves previously stored excess; raw ushort base bounds apply.
reason: Import/load is not a new ordinary gain. Skills roundtrip fixture preserves 1000.1 at cap 1000.0.

trigger: Lazy Skills indexer creates a zero-base Skill in this baseline.
guards: Constructor accepts raw values; the sole compiled non-reader caller supplies base zero.
maximum: 0 through the current caller; a future caller with nonzero base requires review.
reason: Creation of default skill records does not add real points.

trigger: Total-cap primitives called by origin/progression, loading, staff or XML.
guards: No reconciliation with existing base points; no lock check.
maximum: max(0, existing real total - new cap); arbitrary integer cap has no gameplay lower bound here.
reason: Can create over-cap state by lowering the limit, with no skill gain.

trigger: Public cached-total setter; XML nested property assignment is fixture-proven.
guards: No recomputation, access annotation or consistency validation inside setter.
maximum: Gains can fill any artificial cache deficit, bounded by raw base limits and other callers' guards.
reason: Real total 1000.0/cache 999.9 permits normal gain to real 1000.1/cache 1000.0. Serialization recomputes the cache.

trigger: Skill collection load/migration.
guards: Loads cap; sums raw bases; legacy cached total discarded. No cap normalization.
maximum: Preserves existing raw excess; cannot itself manufacture raw points from cached total.
reason: Restart repairs a falsified cache but retains real points until another policy path changes them.

trigger: Mobile/Skills default construction or zero-skill lazy initialization.
guards: Default total zero, default cap 7000 tenths, base zero.
reason: Character creation later sets the shard origin cap before initial skill allocation.

trigger: World save or explicit Skills.Serialize.
guards: Recomputes cached total from bases; serializes rather than normalizes base/cap state.
maximum: 0 newly granted points; can reveal an already excessive real total.
reason: Fixture proves both cache correction and preservation of excess through Skills save/load. Ordinary save loop pauses network processing.

trigger: Mobile load, including persisted Player flag and Skills collection.
guards: Does not enforce aggregate cap; Player flag is read from save.
maximum: Preserves prior excess or false flag; future gain exposure depends on other guards.
reason: PlayerMobile class identity and Mobile.Player boolean are not equivalent checks.

trigger: Flag primitive; normal character creation sets true; staff/NPC clone paths set false; XML can set public properties.
guards: Setter has no class-identity consistency check. Gain waives aggregate check for Player=false.
maximum: Up to combined individual-cap headroom (plus per-gain overshoot) over total cap if an actual PlayerMobile has false flag.
reason: False flag on a PlayerMobile permits fixture gain past total cap. No normal player source path setting its own flag false was found.

trigger: PlayerMobile load and legacy migration.
guards: Reads/migrates SkillStart, SkillBoost and SkillEther, then replaces Skills.Cap with their sum; bases unchanged.
maximum: max(0, existing real total - recomputed cap).
reason: Inconsistent old cap/components can become excessive on restart. Full PlayerMobile load is source analysis, not the Skills-only roundtrip fixture.

trigger: Progression component setters, staff command properties and XML.
guards: Assign component fields only; do not atomically reconcile cap or base points.
maximum: Depends on next SkillBegin/load cap recomputation; max(0, total - new component sum).
reason: Component drift is possible independently of a gain and may be repaired or rejected by region verification.

trigger: BaseRegion.OnEnter for PlayerMobile below Counselor, including applicable parent entries.
guards: Hard-coded allowed cap tiers, cached Total <= Cap, profession/virtue gate for 1300/1800; ignores locks on failure.
maximum: No gain. Erases every base skill on failure, even with an under-cap real total.
reason: Also changes origin/profession/components and can reset raw stats. Classification denotes invalid-state handling, not a gain exploit.

trigger: Character creation, greeter origin selection, Savage/Wanted/Crash entry, verification reset.
guards: Cap = origin start + current configured boost + Ether; does not lower existing skills.
maximum: max(0, total - new cap); e.g. total 2000.0/cap 4000.0 becomes cap 1100.0 with 900.0 excess.
reason: Established-player access to relevant origin location/gump is required; saved-world reachability is not available.

trigger: Alien origin setup, including eligible CrashRegion entry.
guards: After setting alien cap, explicitly zeros every base skill regardless of locks.
maximum: 0 final total excess; destructive independent origin reset.
reason: Explains a separate way to lose skills, not a source of added real points.

trigger: Pagan quest approach with owned ObeliskTip.
guards: Adds 5000 tenths cap and sets Ether=5000; consumes owned tips. Acquisition checks stat cap; handler lacks its own already-Ether check.
maximum: No raw gain. Duplicate/stale eligibility can make cap/component state disagree, then later load/reset invalidates it.
reason: Ordinary one-time use only raises cap safely. Repeat depends on duplicate/stale quest state; no live evidence supplied.

trigger: Legacy veteran login rewards, disabled by Enabled=false in this baseline.
guards: Only legacy 7000/7050/7100/7150/7200 caps are adjusted; does not compare real total before setting cap.
maximum: Up to 20.0 cap reduction from 720.0 to 700.0 for an otherwise valid legacy state; more if state was already excessive.
reason: Disabled feature retained as conditional; its legacy cap tiers also conflict with current region whitelist.

trigger: Ordinary skill checks, spells, regeneration, offline training and accelerated gain; normal Player=true and correct cache.
guards: Up lock and base below individual cap at entry; optional Down loss; final cached total + final increment <= total cap.
maximum: 0 new aggregate excess with valid state. Individual overshoot: up to 1.9 points with a low custom cap and acceleration.
reason: Production-method fixtures include normal/accelerated boundaries. False Player flag and falsified cached total are separate conditional findings.

trigger: A voter chooses a candidate; candidate receives reward when NeedsForensics is enabled (false in baseline).
guards: Unique voter per election; direct candidate Forensics.Base += 0.1 ignores lock and both caps, after ordinary CheckSkill.
maximum: Up to 0.1 extra per successful vote; repeated candidates bounded by Forensics reaching 100.0 (floating truncation can reduce increments).
reason: Automatic player-triggered configured reward, distinct from staff directly setting skills. Same-voter replay does not grant again.

trigger: Staff-authored spawner/quest/dialog property action, potentially triggered by a player's skill use or other event.
guards: SKILL,name writes Base directly. Generic nested property setters lack skill policy; protected list contains only AccessLevel/StaffLevel.
maximum: Arbitrary raw base within ushort range, arbitrary integer total cap/cache, or Player flag; depends on configured action.
reason: Fixture confirms direct real gain and cached-total bypass. No configured mutation action in available input scan; saved deployed actions unresolved.

trigger: Player uses positive-value transcendence scroll in backpack.
guards: Up lock, individual cap, final aggregate headroom; sufficient Down loss before addition; consumed scroll cannot replay.
maximum: 0 new excess from valid state; already invalid state may be retained or rejected.
reason: Actual Use fixture covers full total, donor/no donor and repeated use. Staff-invalid item values are not ordinary rewards.

trigger: SkillStone SetSkillsGump response, where a staff-supplied stone exists.
guards: Checks requested increase against stone limit, individual cap and current total per entry. Does not honor skill lock.
maximum: 0 aggregate excess for accepted ordinary finite values.
reason: Actual response fixture checks fractional boundary and repeats. Missing response ownership/deletion checks are separate item-use weaknesses.

trigger: Player soulstone storage/transfer confirmation; account/location/combat checks in CheckUse.
guards: Storage clears source; transfer rechecks current locks, individual cap and fixed-point headroom, lowers eligible Down points first.
maximum: 0 new aggregate excess from valid state; insufficient Down points reject transfer.
reason: Actual response fixtures including repeat; only CheckUse eligibility is stubbed in fixtures, transfer arithmetic is production.

trigger: NPC teaches eligible player a supported skill, with payment/teacher constraints in calling path.
guards: Up target, individual cap, total free points, enough Down points; final sanity check before target write.
maximum: 0 new aggregate excess from valid state.
reason: Actual CheckTeachSkills fixture covers refusal and sufficient donor lowering.

trigger: New character creation packet; newly allocated PlayerMobile, Player=true.
guards: Origin cap initialized; initial skill array validates unique skills, 0..50 values and total 100/120, or uses bounded profession presets.
maximum: 0 against shard minimum origin cap of 1000.0.
reason: No existing character's high total is reused for initial allocation.

trigger: Test-center speech if enabled; player changes skill or receives individual caps.
guards: ChangeSkill checks individual cap and fixed-point aggregate resulting total; RaiseCaps only increases individual caps.
maximum: 0 new aggregate excess from valid state.
reason: Lock semantics differ intentionally for test center, but total remains bounded.

trigger: Player consumes a power scroll.
guards: Raises one individual skill cap; does not add base points or alter total cap.
reason: Allows later gain only through ordinary total-checked paths.

trigger: Death penalty or forgetful-gem confirmation.
guards: Only multiplies bases by loss factors or zeros a skill.
maximum: 0 newly added points.
reason: Can remove or retain prior excess, cannot cause it from a valid state.

trigger: Staff clone/conversion, GmMe, SetSkill/SetAllSkills or skill editor; command gates documented in report.
guards: Direct writes generally ignore aggregate cap and locks; EditSkill response checks GM access.
maximum: Configured value(s), ultimately bounded by raw ushort skill base; GmMe sets every skill to 120.0.
reason: Authorized staff actions can deliberately leave a player above cap; staff-clone false flag is not normal player input.

trigger: NPC/pet creation, cloning illusions, balancing, upgrade, migration, taming or resurrection.
guards: Receiver proven BaseCreature or its subclass; PlayerMobile is a different Mobile subclass. Some paths intentionally ignore NPC caps.
maximum: 0 to a player's real skill total.
reason: These typed NPC writes do not directly mutate PlayerMobile skills; later staff-control copying is separately classified. 5297 BaseCreature.SetSkill call sites are inventoried.

trigger: Normal offline clone creation targets an NPC; staff CloneCommands.CopyMobileState also copies raw skills into the controlling staff PlayerMobile.
guards: Helper itself has no aggregate/individual cap or lock guard; player-target callers are staff clone/control/restore workflows.
maximum: Copied source total minus recipient cap; source raw values may exceed ordinary player limits.
reason: Includes staff possession/restoration, not only offline NPC clones. Counselor access gates initiate the workflow; saved/demoted control ownership would be historical conditional state.

trigger: Offline-character NPC clone creation; item/mount property copy.
guards: Current skill-copy caller targets CharacterClone : BaseCreature; reflected item attributes and mounts are not player Skills.
maximum: 0 to the original player's real skill total.
reason: Skill-copy helper with staff player targets is classified separately. These remaining clone flag/item/mount writes do not change the original player's base skills.

trigger: Item-copy helpers, including staff duplication and gift box.
guards: Reflection source and destination are Item instances, not player Skill/Skills collections.
maximum: 0 directly to real base points; cloned skill bonuses are effective values only.
reason: Any later consumable's real-point behavior is covered at its actual mutation sink.

trigger: Staff properties/set/increase commands or staff/XML property-edit gumps, with property write access enforced at entry.
guards: Primitive reflection writer does not enforce skill cap/locks. Property editors require a writable CommandProperty and its access level.
maximum: Arbitrary eligible property value within target setter bounds.
reason: No normal player property-editor entry was found. XML automated property actions use separately classified BaseXmlSpawner helpers.
